author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix(crawl): review round 2 - 504, unhandled rejection, perf, search window

- route.ts: return 504 Gateway Timeout for timeout errors instead of a generic
  500. Detects both AbortSignal.timeout's DOMException (name === "TimeoutError")
  and the withTimeout() helper's Error("Crawl timeout").

- cache.ts: fix a latent unhandled rejection. promise.finally() returns a new
  derived promise whose rejection would be orphaned (since nothing awaited it).
  Now we store the derived "settled" promise in the inFlight map and return it,
  so the caller's await observes the rejection. Identity check compares against
  the derived promise for the same reason.

- crawler.ts: replace O(n²) includes/push aggregation with per-talk Set-backed
  tracking (followSets, rsvpSets, postLists). Projected to TalkMention arrays
  via buildResult() at the end, so the exported shape is unchanged.

- search.ts: extend SEARCH_UNTIL to 2026-04-27T00:00:00.000Z (exclusive upper
  bound = through end of April 26, 2026). Intentionally beyond the spec's
  conference window so Understory keeps surfacing post-conference aftermath
  discussion after the event ends.

author: Bryan Guffey
message:
fix(crawl): review fixes - abort signal, atomic in-flight, nested embeds

- route.ts: atomically register/join crawls via registerCrawl so concurrent
  requests can't overwrite each other's in-flight promise. New crawls own an
  AbortSignal.timeout(30s) so a timeout actually cancels outbound fetches
  rather than just detaching the handler. Joined requests wrap their wait in a
  separate Promise.race timeout (can't cancel another caller's work).
  withTimeout helper clears the timer on settlement so it doesn't leak.

- cache.ts: replace getInFlightCrawl/setInFlightCrawl with atomic
  registerCrawl(did, factory) -> { promise, isNew }. Cleanup only deletes the
  entry when the map still references this exact promise (identity check), so
  a stale finally from an overwritten promise can't erase a newer one.

- crawler.ts / constellation.ts / search.ts: thread an optional AbortSignal
  through fetchFollows, fetchRsvps, searchConferencePosts and into every
  fetch() / agent.* call via CallOptions. Check signal.aborted at loop
  boundaries and rethrow abort errors from search.ts catch so a timeout
  actually unwinds the crawl instead of being swallowed.

- matcher.ts: extract collectRecordUris() and handle the nested
  app.bsky.embed.recordWithMedia shape where embed.record is itself a
  record#view with its own .record.uri. Applied to both view-level (post.embed)
  and record-level (post.record.embed) containers.

SEARCH_UNTIL intentionally not changed: spec §3 and CLAUDE.md both pin the
window at since:2026-03-26 / until:2026-04-06, and searchPosts treats until
as exclusive, so the current value correctly covers all of April 5 (the last
conference day).
